page.layout: One page of text, one block, set in italic type. No running head, page number, catchword or signature. Below the text are stains and show-through, which are left out. A horizontal rule lies near the foot and is not text.

p.i: faciam, doceam, cum omni sobrietate et prudentia, quæ ipsius gloriæ, Ecclesiæ Christi ædificationi, matris Academiæ honori et ornatui, studiosorum in vera fide et conscientiæ puritate profectui, meæ denique ipsius et paci internæ et æternæ saluti aliquà ex parte inservi-ant; per et propter merita Domini no-stri Jesu Christi, cui cum Patre et Spi-ritu sancto Tri-uni Deo, sit omnis honos, laus et gloria in secula seculorum.

page.notes: The text is set in italic throughout. Long s is transcribed as plain s and i/j as printed in the scan: "Jesu" is printed with a J, and I have kept it as the printer set it. "saluti" has a final vowel that I could not confirm with certainty; it is probably "salutì" or "saluti". The horizontal rule and the stains lower on the page are not text and are left out.
